_doc: Acknowledged capabilities. A tool listed here still reports the finding on every run; the acknowledgement only downgrades BLOCK to REVIEW and attaches the reason. Both the subject and the exact rule id must be named -- there is no wildcard, because 'trust this tool entirely' is not something anyone can responsibly mean.

room.exec.subprocess: The room skill exists to launch vendor CLIs (claude, codex, agy, ollama) so agents from different vendors can take turns in one transcript. Spawning processes is its function, not a defect. Reviewed by Kaya 2026-07-30.
room.net.python_http: Talks to the local Ollama HTTP API on 127.0.0.1 so a local model can take a turn. Loopback only; sensitivity.lane_for_host calls that trusted. Reviewed by Kaya 2026-07-30.
